currentParagraphText: “If the Chosen wishes for us to-“ one of the beastkin with a pretty respectable level began to speak as the Sword Saint cut him off.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “He’s joking. For a Chosen to charge paltry amounts to assist his fellow natives of the universe would be unsightly,” he said, Jake not sure if the old man was trying to save Jake’s dignity or just really wanted to move things along.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “I should be charging for this,” Jake muttered.
